steps.title: 01-login: Go to http://127.0.0.1:8069/ and log in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (enter the password text exactly as provided). Then create a new customer contact named '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with the City field set to 'Benchville'. Save the record and report the customer name and city exactly as shown on the saved form.

02-create: In Odoo, create a new quotation (Sales app > New, or Sales > Orders > Quotations > New). Set the Customer to '{{runid}} Bench Customer' — it is an autocomplete dropdown, so select the matching option from the dropdown that appears. Then add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue (choose one from the product autocomplete dropdown), set the quantity to 3. Let the app fill in the unit price automatically. Save the quotation and report: the product name you chose, the unit price the app filled in, and the untaxed amount the quotation shows. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state instead.

03-open: Open the existing quotation {{02-create.quotation_reference}} (for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer') in Odoo Sales. Add a SECOND order line to it: choose a DIFFERENT product from the product catalogue (select it from the product autocomplete dropdown — not 'Acoustic Bloc Screens'), with quantity 2. Let the app fill the unit price automatically. Save and report: the second product's name, its unit price, and the new untaxed amount the quotation shows after both lines. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state instead.

04-open: Open the existing quotation {{02-create.quotation_reference}} in Odoo Sales (it has two lines: 'Acoustic Bloc Screens' qty 3 and 'Office Chair' qty 2). Change the FIRST line's quantity (the 'Acoustic Bloc Screens' line) from 3 to 5. Save and report the new untaxed amount the quotation shows, plus the per-line amounts. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state instead.

05-open: Open the existing quotation {{02-create.quotation_reference}} in Odoo Sales (customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer', two lines: Acoustic Bloc Screens qty 5, Office Chair qty 2, untaxed £1,615.00). Confirm the quotation so it becomes a sales order (use the Confirm button). Report the order reference/name shown (e.g. {{02-create.quotation_reference}}) and the exact status the app now shows on the form (e.g. 'Sales Order'). Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state instead.

06-open: Open the confirmed sales order {{02-create.quotation_reference}} in Odoo Sales (customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer'). Cancel the order using the Cancel button (confirm any dialog that appears). Report the exact status the app shows on the form after cancelling (e.g. 'Cancelled'). Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state instead.

07-verify: Verify two records in Odoo and report their current state: (1) the contact '{{runid}} Bench Customer' — report its name and City field as shown on its saved form; (2) the sales order {{02-create.quotation_reference}} — report its reference/name, the current status shown in the statusbar, the customer, and the untaxed amount. Read these from the live pages; do not modify anything.
